steps.name: Wang
steps.text: ...I see.

steps.name: Wang
steps.text: Do not tell anyone else. Be extremely careful.

steps.name: Wang
steps.text: I need you to do something for me.

steps.name: Jun
steps.text: The Judicial Review Office has begun to investigate everyone who was near the Sky Mirror Pavilion around the time that the writing knife was stolen.

steps.name: Jie
steps.text: Outside of our siblings, you could count the number of people who know about the existence of the knife with one hand.

steps.name: Jun
steps.text: Yes, it's just as I feared.

steps.name: Jun
steps.text: I won't stand aside and do nothing if someone tries to harm you, Jie.

steps.name: Jie
steps.text: I doubt someone trying to harm me would use such means.

steps.name: Jie
steps.text: It feels more like a warning.

steps.name: Jie
steps.text: His Imperial Majesty is an energetic ruler. He wanted every 'person' in the land to bow to him. He would recognize our family as not being of his kind.

steps.name: Jie
steps.text: But I do not believe he would stoop so low as to use the knife in underhanded ways.

steps.name: Jun
steps.text: It's not fair. If there's anyone who should be above suspicion, it would be you.

steps.name: Jie
steps.text: You know how hard the words 'fair and just' are to write... it's as our oldest brother says. There is little point in arguing when it's a thousand mouths against one.

steps.name: Jun
steps.text: I doubt he would just let this slide, if he was here.

steps.name: Jie
steps.text: Hehe...

steps.name: Jie
steps.text: I wouldn't like to see him when he's angry.

steps.name: Jun
steps.text: What is your plan? You won't tell Wang about it?

steps.name: Jun
steps.text: It's times like these that he is most useful.
Jie shakes her head.

steps.name: Jie
steps.text: That was what I was about to ask you... please, keep this a secret from Wang.

steps.name: Jie
steps.text: People have feared and avoided him for many years. His position has grown even more precarious under the new emperor. This is not the time to drag him into this.

steps.name: Jie
steps.text: Besides, I fear he will do something irrational if he finds out.

steps.name: Jun
steps.text: Alright, I'll listen to you.

steps.name: Jun
steps.text: But I hope you can be honest with me, Jie.

steps.name: Jun
steps.text: Are you absolutely sure that you and Wang are not plotting something?

steps.name: Jie
steps.text: Come on, don't interrogate me like this, sister.

steps.name: Jie
steps.text: I guess no one can lie to you successfully.

steps.name: Jun
steps.text: I knew it.

steps.name: Jun
steps.text: You understand that it's a dangerous power you wield.

steps.name: Jie
steps.text: I know the risks. But I'm not the only one who has to shoulder them.

steps.name: Jie
steps.text: Shuo, Wang, Ling and you... you've done so much for us the younger ones. I have to do my part.

steps.name: Jie
steps.text: Besides, I don't want these names that I put so much thought into to fade away in history.
Jun continues to frown. Jie takes her sister's hands in hers. They are rough from all the years of playing instruments, but it is a comfortable feeling.

steps.name: Jie
steps.text: I'm here. I'm alright.

steps.name: Jie
steps.text: Don't worry...

steps.name: Jie
steps.text: You know, I had a dream, a dream about our future.

steps.name: Jie
steps.text: It's a different future from the fields of white that Shu spoke of.

steps.name: Jie
steps.text: I saw all of you truly live as yourselves.

steps.name: Jie
steps.text: The vision was so real, it didn't seem like a dream. I even have a feeling...

steps.name: Jie
steps.text: A feeling that it's more than just a dream...

steps.name: Liang
steps.text: It's good to see you, Miss Nian.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Hey, Round-head. You're the one supervising the work?

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: What about the 'foreman'? Where's he slacking off?

steps.name: Liang
steps.text: You misunderstand. My master has been very busy with city design ever since he received news of Baizao's modification. He has gone an entire month without sleep at his busiest.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: That slowpoke picks himself up once in a while, eh?

steps.name: Liang
steps.text: He calls Yan's first-ever nomadic city a project of monumental significance. Every detail of the city must be carefully considered.

steps.name: Liang
steps.text: Therefore, he must complete it before you have a chance to do something to his design.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: What the—!

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: How dare he talk behind my back like this, when I always share the good stuff with him?!

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Where is he? I'll bite his head off for this—

steps.name: Liang
steps.text: Sleeping.

steps.name: Liang
steps.text: He has slept for ten days now, but he is supposed to deliver the draft of the gates to the Ministry of Works today.

steps.name: Liang
steps.text: He told me that I am to stop the ministry's people from getting in, no matter what.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Ha! Now that's the Yi I know.

steps.name: Liang
steps.text: Is there something else?

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: You said Yi's sleeping...

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: I remember that he picked up a meteorite a few decades ago... it's still in his garden, isn't it? Where?

steps.name: Liang
steps.text: Miss Nian... I have my master's instructions. I am not to allow anyone into the Garden of Grotesqueries, whether it is you or anyone from the Ministry of Works.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Why are you so loyal to him? Say, wasn't it I who gave him the materials to build your body? You should obey MY orders!

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Now shut up and get out of the way!

steps.name: Liang
steps.text: Please, Miss Nian... you make my position most difficult—

steps.name: Ministry of Works Official
steps.text: Mr. Liang, Miss Nian. The Assistant Minister requests your urgent presence at the Forbidden City.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Urgent? How much?

steps.name: Ministry of Works Official
steps.text: The Baizao project has encountered a snag...

steps.name: Ministry of Works Official
steps.text: A shipment of materials, Oriron and Originium and the like, which Baizao urgently needs, has been delayed.

steps.name: Ministry of Works Official
steps.text: It has brought construction to a grinding halt.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: What the...

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: What are the geezers at the Ministry of Works doing?

steps.name: Minister of Works
steps.text: What is going on... I demand an explanation!

steps.name: Minister of Works
steps.text: The construction of Baizao is the most important thing in the land! How could this be allowed to happen?!

steps.name: Minister of Works
steps.text: The Chidao around the capital is well-maintained. How could it collapse when no Catastrophe has occurred? And how could there be bandits so close to the capital?

steps.name: Skeptical Ministry of Works Official
steps.text: I have to say that these incidents are highly suspicious, sir.

steps.name: Skeptical Ministry of Works Official
steps.text: The sudden collapse, and the supplies that disappeared without reason, then showed up just as suddenly where they should not...

steps.name: Skeptical Ministry of Works Official
steps.text: If there is indeed someone behind all this, then their objective must be to sow confusion.

steps.name: Skeptical Ministry of Works Official
steps.text: Rumors have been spreading in the city. Many workers believe that Baizao picked a time of ill fortune to begin construction.

steps.name: Minister of Works
steps.text: Someone is sowing confusion? Who?

steps.name: Anxious Ministry of Works Official
steps.text: Sir, the Minister of Rites requests a meeting.

steps.name: Minister of Works
steps.text: What is Rites doing here at a time like this? Did they come to laugh at us?

steps.name: Anxious Ministry of Works Official
steps.text: Reporting, sir: the Minister of Rites said that although the Ministry of Works has been quite busy of late, this trouble involves more than just the Ministry of Works...

steps.name: Sui Regulator Supervisor
steps.text: There you are, Chun.

steps.name: Sui Regulator Supervisor
steps.text: Do you know why I have summoned you?

steps.name: Chun
steps.text: I suppose... it's because of the writing knife.

steps.name: Sui Regulator Supervisor
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Sui Regulator Supervisor
steps.text: How do you propose to solve this dilemma?

steps.name: Chun
steps.text: Perhaps, if you could... put in a few good words for her, and return it to its owner...

steps.name: Sui Regulator Supervisor
steps.text: Ha.

steps.name: Sui Regulator Supervisor
steps.text: Go on.

steps.name: Chun
steps.text: If the numbers are the problem, it's as simple a matter as going over her head to alter them... this should not be necessary.

steps.name: Sui Regulator Supervisor
steps.text: How interesting. Her previous Candleholder retired after being accused of growing too close to her proxy... she has a knack for winning people over, doesn't she?

steps.name: Chun
steps.text: She... I mean, all the proxies have their own eccentricities. But they have never plotted against Yan—

steps.name: Sui Regulator Supervisor
steps.text: Indeed, we can tolerate the eccentricities of others, as long as they do not seek to harm Yan.

steps.name: Sui Regulator Supervisor
steps.text: But she...

steps.name: Sui Regulator Supervisor
steps.text: You must understand what you are dealing with, and what her powers mean to Yan.
The Supervisor tosses the unsubmitted document towards Chun, and hands her a writing brush dipped in ink.

steps.name: Sui Regulator Supervisor
steps.text: Try.

steps.name: Sui Regulator Supervisor
steps.text: Try, if you think you can go over the head of the proxy. Change the numbers to what you want them to be.

steps.name: Ministry of Rites Official
steps.text: Your Imperial Majesty... the Ministries of Rites and Works have completed the investigation into the lost supplies for the Baizao project.

steps.name: Ministry of Rites Official
steps.text: The investigators unanimously agree that it was most likely an intentional act... and that there was someone behind it.

steps.name: Ministry of Rites Official
steps.text: The supplies have arrived at Baizao. The Ministry of Works will do its best to make up for lost progress...

steps.name: True Lung
steps.text: What are you hiding?

steps.name: True Lung
steps.text: You suspect that there is someone behind it. You must have a suspect.
The nervous official dares not look straight at the figure behind the curtain. Out of the corner of the eye, he glimpses his majestic lord standing before his desk, writing something.

steps.name: True Lung
steps.text: A well-timed declaration of war. Two, in fact.

steps.name: True Lung
steps.text: One, telling me that she is the sole mouth of Yan, while the other demonstrating that he can easily disrupt Yan's greatest project, that the continuation of the project depends on his approval.

steps.name: True Lung
steps.text: Will there come a day when they could make Yan's armies turn on themselves if they wanted?

steps.name: Ministry of Rites Official
steps.text: This is a most serious matter, Your Majesty. If the proxies are indeed stirring trouble, the Sui Regulator should act immediately and punish them severely.

steps.name: True Lung
steps.text: There is no need to be hasty.
The figure behind the curtain thinks for a moment, then puts down his writing brush.

steps.name: True Lung
steps.text: I know the craft of calligraphy must be honed over a long period, but I have not seen the efforts bear fruit...

steps.name: True Lung
steps.text: Still, I understand now why the Grand Preceptor wanted me to spend so much time on it.

steps.name: True Lung
steps.text: One must be in control of oneself.
The young True Lung gazes upon the ink on the paper, but he seems dissatisfied and frowns.
'Jin Ye Ming Yue Ren Jin Wang'—The moon's wan gloom drew every eye.

spans.text: 'Jin Ye Ming Yue Ren Jin Wang'—The moon's wan gloom drew every eye.

steps.text: He picks up the writing knife and uses it to scrape away the conspicuous character of 'Wang'.
In an instant, that patch of paper is white as new again.

steps.name: True Lung
steps.text: He is clever, unlike his pedantic sister. He knew to let the supplies arrive at Baizao eventually, make a show of good faith.

steps.name: True Lung
steps.text: He wished to protest on behalf of his sister. I'll humor his brotherly love. They can record the figures as they like.

steps.name: True Lung
steps.text: As for this writing knife...

steps.name: True Lung
steps.text: I had considered doing something with it, but...

steps.name: True Lung
steps.text: Never mind. Return it.

steps.name: Chun
steps.text: Jie...

steps.name: Chun
steps.text: The Sui Regulator has recovered your item.

steps.name: Jie
steps.text: Thank you.

steps.name: Chun
steps.text: I'm so sorry, Jie...

steps.name: Jie
steps.text: Why apologize? You found the thing that I lost.

steps.name: Jie
steps.text: That which was lost has been restored. All is well.

steps.name: Chun
steps.text: I was negligent in my duty.

steps.name: Chun
steps.text: There's something I've always wanted to ask you, Jie.

steps.name: Chun
steps.text: You said you didn't want to use the writing knife to alter history, not even to change clerical errors. Why have you kept the knife around?

steps.name: Jie
steps.text: Did you forget that you already asked this question when you were three months on the job? You complained when I didn't allow you to use the writing knife to correct errors.

steps.name: Chun
steps.text: I-Is that so? I don't really remember...

steps.name: Jie
steps.text: Have you forgotten about your original aspiration, now that the erroneous descriptions of Yaan Elves have been addressed?

steps.name: Chun
steps.text: No, I just...

steps.name: Jie
steps.text: It's true that one should not pursue what lies in the past. But just as you and I have demonstrated, it does not mean that we should ignore the errors of the past, never mind trying to whitewash them.

steps.name: Jie
steps.text: I have kept the knife so that people will remember that wrongs can always be righted.

steps.name: Chun
steps.text: ...I understand.

steps.name: Chun
steps.text: Nothing could be changed... tearing the pages out, writing over the words, they all do nothing because the page is instantly restored to its original state... how could this be?

steps.name: Chun
steps.text: How could this be?

steps.name: Sui Regulator Supervisor
steps.text: This is her power.

steps.name: Sui Regulator Supervisor
steps.text: She was not so difficult a hundred years ago, when it was proposed that she should leave the Imperial Historical Cabinet and refrain from writing the histories directly.

steps.name: Sui Regulator Supervisor
steps.text: She did not complain, and indeed transferred to the Sky Mirror Pavilion of her own accord to work on reviews. She also reduced the number of courses she taught at the Academy, mostly working in an advisory capacity, similar to how Jun operates.

steps.name: Sui Regulator Supervisor
steps.text: But her photographic memory, enthusiasm for history, and her immortality, were too much of a temptation to historians.

steps.name: Sui Regulator Supervisor
steps.text: It became their habit to seek the approval of the one who is never wrong, and she is happy to take on the work, reviewing documents and histories...

steps.name: Sui Regulator Supervisor
steps.text: Today, nothing that passes through her hands can be altered without her approval.

steps.name: Sui Regulator Supervisor
steps.text: As for the writing knife that occupies so much of your mind... it was once an ordinary tool, when Jie first picked it up.

steps.name: Sui Regulator Supervisor
steps.text: After spending centuries by Jie's side, it became capable of altering text without having to carve out bamboo.

steps.name: Sui Regulator Supervisor
steps.text: Two centuries later, the writing knife accidentally erased a page from the veritable records of a True Lung.

steps.name: Sui Regulator Supervisor
steps.text: Few, if any, ever perused those pages, and all who knew the subject were gone. And so, when a careless historian's hand slipped, no one could recall what the page held anymore.

steps.name: Sui Regulator Supervisor
steps.text: One reason was that no copies were made of the veritable records. But it is also true that Jie's powers are growing.

steps.name: Sui Regulator Supervisor
steps.text: If the Sui Regulator, or Jie herself, chooses to erase a word, a sentence, or perhaps a memory from under heaven with it... it is well within the realm of possibility.

steps.name: Sui Regulator Supervisor
steps.text: The knife represents only a fragment of Jie's powers. How fast are her own powers growing?

steps.name: Sui Regulator Supervisor
steps.text: The deeper Yan's history grows, the harder it will become to rein her in, for she is one with history.

steps.name: Sui Regulator Supervisor
steps.text: In another century or ten, as she continues to immerse herself in history, she will become more powerful, more terrible, even than the bestial Sui Itself.
The long-lived Candleholder stands dumbfounded, hardly able to comprehend what she has just heard.

steps.name: Chun
steps.text: If that's all, I will return to the Sky Mirror Pavilion.

steps.name: Jie
steps.text: Very well. Be careful.

steps.name: Jie
steps.text: Wang...?

steps.name: Wang
steps.text: Are you alright?

steps.name: Jie
steps.text: I'm fine.

steps.name: Jie
steps.text: Wang, did you...?
Silence. They have grown used to this tacit understanding between them, in the long centuries that they have spent together.
Jie clearly sees the emotions in his eyes.
Flames of fury, well-hidden, but burning nonetheless.

steps.name: Wang
steps.text: It happened a century ago. I still remember the conflict that occurred because of the writing knife.

steps.name: Wang
steps.text: What is it that you want me to see, this time?

a.text: I thought you would charge recklessly into the dream and tear it apart.
You call yourself a schemer. Did you not see how the seeds of your end were already sown?
The hearts of men are fickle...

steps.name: Wang
steps.text: I don't need you to tell me.

steps.name: Wang
steps.text: So you did not interfere in my power struggle against the True Lung.

a.text: Does it matter that you know? You dug your own grave. I did not need to do anything.
Besides, you have not seen the full picture of how the event led to her ultimate demise.
The end is near. Are you ready?
